name: blueprint/design-snapshot
description: Capture a site's design tokens as data: browse it, extract colors/type/spacing, store the snapshot, generate a reference artifact and publish it
ingredients: harness browser tools for the capture
recipe: browse the site and extract tokens -> store the dated snapshot -> generate the reference artifact (agent-built) -> publish and share
pitfalls: the snapshot is dated - re-snap on redesign
tokens are facts, the artifact is a view - store both
the dsh-versatile-design skill covers the craft; this kit is the capture pipeline
